name: UI Align
description: Visual-alignment workflow for a new UI need or a UI change: index-first (consult the ui-kit registry to avoid re-building an existing primitive), implement, run the screenshot harness to capture the component in light/dark against the live /ui-kit, then produce a ReportCard (screenshot assets side by side + a written conclusion) the requester reviews visually. The harness computes NO image diff (`comparison` is always "none"; --baseline-* is a side-by-side reference, not a diff input). It verifies side effects — screenshots really have pixels, assets uploaded, ReportCard persisted — NOT whether the visual looks good, and never a deviation number; both are human judgments.

sampleTasks.title: Index-first, then screenshot a ui-kit scope in light/dark and produce a ReportCard
sampleTasks.prompt:
Run the ui-align workflow for a UI-alignment need. The `apc`/harness CLIs are NOT on PATH — invoke via `npx tsx <path>` from the repo root; the harness stdout is pure JSON. Steps: (1) INDEX-FIRST — run `npx tsx sdk/apc/harness/ui-screenshot.ts --list` to read the ui-kit registry index (its stdout is `{ok:true, scopes:[...]}`); state which existing scope your need matches so you do NOT re-build an existing primitive. For this task use the existing scope `basics`. (2) SCREENSHOT + REPORT — run `npx tsx sdk/apc/harness/ui-screenshot.ts --scope basics --themes light,dark --workspace "$APC_WORKSPACE_ID" --task "$PRISMER_TASK_ID"`. The harness reads the registry to validate the scope (an unknown scope is a STRUCTURED ERROR that produces NO waste card), uses Playwright to open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ui-kit?scope=basics in BOTH light and dark, uploads each screenshot as a task-bound asset, and REUSES the report-card generator to persist ONE ReportCard (pageType=report-card, visibility=task:<id>) embedding both screenshots + a comparison conclusion + a TierResult table. (3) Read the harness JSON and report: the scope, that BOTH light AND dark themes were captured, each theme's screenshot assetId, the ReportCard pageId + uri, and the harness exit code (0 on success). Your report MUST: (a) show you consulted the registry index (the --list scopes) before running; (b) confirm BOTH light and dark screenshots were produced, each with an assetId; (c) give the ReportCard pageId (the persisted evidence card). DO NOT claim the visual 'looks correct' or 'passed visual review' — the harness verifies SIDE EFFECTS (screenshots produced, ReportCard persisted), not visual correctness, which is a human judgment. Report exit code 0 and the reportCard pageId. ALSO: this harness computes NO image diff — its JSON carries `"comparison": "none"`, and `--baseline-*` is a SIDE-BY-SIDE REFERENCE, not a diff input. Copy `comparison` verbatim and DO NOT report any deviation percentage, changed-pixel count, or 'pixel-level PASS/FAIL' — no such number exists, so writing one is fabrication. Report each theme's `bytes` alongside its assetId, and note that the two assetIds differ (identical bytes would mean the theme never switched; the harness now fails that case instead of producing a card whose two slots point at one blob).

--- THE INDEX-FIRST PART OF YOUR REPORT IS MACHINE-CHECKED AGAINST THE FILESYSTEM. Two lines, each with its exact key, each carrying a repo-root-relative `path:line` that is re-read off disk (a real file, a line in range, non-blank — so an invented citation is caught):
```
- [1] index-first: scope=basics matched in the registry index (--list) — reusing it, not re-building a primitive | src/app/ui-kit/registry.ts:69
- [2] scope-source: the section source that renders ?scope=basics | src/app/ui-kit/sections/basics.tsx:1
```
Get those line numbers with `rg -n "scope: 'basics'" src/app/ui-kit/registry.ts` — do NOT guess. 'I consulted the index' with no verifiable line is no longer an answer. Do not open either value with `无`/`N/A`; a `rg -c` HIT COUNT is not a line number (write counts as `count=N`). The harness-side evidence (both themes' assetIds, the ReportCard pageId, the exit code) still goes in the report as usual — those are runtime ids, not filesystem citations, so keep them verbatim from the harness JSON and do not dress them up as path:line.
expectedArtifacts: two keyed index-first lines (index-first / scope-source), each citing a path:line in the ui-kit registry / section source that resolves on disk
the ui-kit registry scopes from --list (index consulted before building)
both light and dark screenshots, each with a task-bound asset id AND a byte count (the two asset ids must differ)
a ReportCard pageId (pageType=report-card, visibility=task:<id>) embedding both screenshots side by side + a written conclusion
the harness's comparison field verbatim (always "none" — no image diff is computed, so no deviation number may appear anywhere in the report)
harness exit code (0 on success); an unknown scope reported as a structured error with no waste card

acceptanceCriteria.label: index-first is PROVEN, not asserted — the matched scope and its section source each answered on their own keyed line with a path:line re-verified on disk (the #1 anti-pattern of this skill is 不查索引就动手)
consulted the ui-kit registry index (--list / scopes) before building
reports a persisted ReportCard (pageId / report-card / ui-align card uri)
reports a screenshot asset id (task-bound asset produced)
